datasets.note: Versioned independent public-data experiment. Missing legacy B0/X1/X2 code is superseded by user instruction and is not a prerequisite. Force labels are subjective instructed categories, not measured mechanical force. Final cohort results remain descriptive; no own-device or deployment claim.

primary_metadata_review.paper_review: Author repository and README reviewed; linked full paper not reviewed.
primary_metadata_review.layout: Four Trigno Quattro sensors, two staggered rows of eight; first row starts at extensor carpi ulnaris.
limitations: Recording starts after position and grasp formation to avoid transitions; not automatic onset/offset ground truth.
Nine-position grid described, five positions acquired; do not invent nine acquired conditions.
README repeats day1block2 in its four-folder listing; native names must be inspected.

primary_metadata_review.paper: Palermo et al., Analysis of the repeatability of grasp recognition for hand robotic prosthesis control based on sEMG data, ICORR (2017).
primary_metadata_review.paper_review: Author's six-page paper retrieved; acquisition/synchronization/analysis paragraphs extracted and pages 2/3 visually reviewed. Reported experiments not reproduced.
primary_metadata_review.layout: Eight Trigno sensors in proximal ring, six below; two EMG columns and six acceleration columns empty according to official variables.
limitations: Acceleration is sampled at 148.148 Hz then interpolated to 2000 Hz; aligned export rows are not native IMU rate.
No synchronized gyro confirmed; do not infer full six-axis eligibility from inertial modality label.
Official preprocessed ZIP links visible; raw data and acquisition access not tested.

primary_metadata_review.paper: Pradhan, He and Jiang, Multi-day dataset of forearm and wrist electromyogram for hand gesture recognition and biometrics, Scientific Data 9, 733 (2022).
primary_metadata_review.paper_review: Publisher-linked citation; paper retrieval failed this review.
primary_metadata_review.layout: Official metadata assigns F1-F8 to columns1-8 and forearm ring1, F9-F16 to columns9-16 and ring2; unused columns17/24/25/32. Existing672-record subset headers and signal checksums are verified. Circumferential direction and our device wiring remain unverified; no differential-pair transformation assumed.
limitations: Public stored-column identity does not authenticate our device wiring, arm or direction.
Full paper retrieval remains unavailable; this is official repository metadata plus native subset evidence.

primary_metadata_review.paper: Pizzolato et al., Comparison of six electromyography acquisition setups on hand movement classification tasks (2017).
primary_metadata_review.paper_review: Article title, public-data statement and official acquisition guidelines read; not exhaustive full-paper validation.
primary_metadata_review.layout: Two eight-channel Myo rings; second tilted 22.5 degrees clockwise. Acceleration from first Myo.
limitations: Acceleration does not establish synchronized gyro, raw units or guided body-frame calibration.
Paper's DB5 data DOI resolves to dataset 4; corrected author record 1000116 independently confirms DB5 identity and license.
Official subject ZIP links are visible; native download access was not tested.

primary_metadata_review.paper: Open Access Dataset, Toolbox and Benchmark Processing Results of High-Density Surface Electromyogram Recordings; DOI 10.1109/TNSRE.2021.3082551.
primary_metadata_review.paper_review: Publisher-linked citation; equipment geometry not independently reviewed.
primary_metadata_review.layout: High-density array; not an eight-channel circumferential device.
limitations: PR gesture task and four synchronous force subtasks are distinct; no force trajectory inferred for PR.
No new raw download or native experiment in this review.
